about_the_game:
Air Force 1 Pinball – A Presidential Pinball Mission!
Take to the skies in this high-stakes Air Force 1-themed pinball table, where you’ll complete classified missions, navigate thrilling aerial maneuvers, and prove your skills in a game of precision and power.

✈️ Authentic Air Force 1 Experience – Play on a table inspired by the iconic presidential aircraft, featuring the Presidential Seal, high-tech security displays, and a White House centerpiece.
🎯 Mission-Based Gameplay – Tackle strategic objectives like crisis response, national defense, and intelligence decryption to unlock special bonuses.
🛫 Dynamic Ramps & Multi-Level Play – Master aircraft maneuvers using a complex system of ramps, bumpers, and high-speed pathways.
💥 High-Stakes Bonus Features – Unlock secret areas, trigger multi-ball missions, and compete for the Presidential Challenge.
🧩 Decoder Room Mini-Game – Enter a high-security command center, crack top-secret codes, and race against time to complete your classified mission.
🔧 Realistic Pinball Physics – Experience authentic multi-ball action, bumper rebounds, and precise flipper control.
🏆 Steam Leaderboards & High Scores – Show off your skills and dominate the rankings in this presidential pinball challenge.
🎶 Dynamic Soundtrack & Immersive Audio – Engage with an adaptive soundtrack featuring intense orchestral scores, aircraft sound effects, and dramatic mission briefings.

Are you ready to take command and lead the ultimate Air Force 1 pinball mission?

🎵 Oval Lounge Rhythm Challenge – Timing is Key!

  • Taking the right ramp will land you in the Oval Lounge, a secretive music club within the White House.

  • The bumpers react to the rhythm of the music, meaning timing your shots correctly can increase your score multiplier!

  • Each music track changes the tempo of the bumpers, making faster beats more challenging but higher scoring.

🎵 How It Works:

  • Hit the right ramp to enter the Oval Lounge.

  • Music starts playing, and the bumpers light up in sync with the beat.

  • Keep the ball in play and hit bumpers in rhythm to increase the score multiplier.

  • Unlock Bonus Blocks at the top by successfully timing your shots with the music!

Air Force One Pinball – Decoder Room Instructions

💻 Mission: Decode & Launch
Your goal is to crack the four-digit launch code using the pinball to press the correct buttons on the Decoder Laptop. If successful, you'll activate the Nuke Stage and unlock massive bonuses!

🎮 How to Use the Ball to Operate the Laptop

1️⃣ Hit the Left or Right Targets

  • Left Target: Decreases the current digit.

  • Right Target: Increases the current digit.

  • Each time the ball hits a target, it cycles through numbers (0-9).

2️⃣ Set All Four Digits

  • Carefully aim the ball to adjust each digit to the correct launch code.

  • Watch for clues on monitors and hidden messages around the playfield!

3️⃣ Confirm the Code

  • Once you think the sequence is correct, hit the center target to lock in the code.

  • If incorrect, you must start over or search for more clues.

  • If correct, the system verifies the code and advances you to the Nuke Stage!

⚠️ Warning: Incorrect Code Consequences

  • A countdown timer forcing quick decisions!

💻 Can you use skillful shots to crack the code, launch the nuke, and complete your mission? 🚀
Good luck, Commander! 🔐🔥

Instructions: ( Keyboard Keys )

S - Left Flipper

D - Left Tilt

L - Right Flipper

K - Right Tilt

Enter - Ball Plunge
